title: 第17章 女帝身份暴露第18章 师父你为什么对我这么好
slug: 我的徒弟们都太逆天了
lines: 见此，众人都惊住了。
什么？
姬扶摇一掌震飞了方岩？
下一瞬间。
众人更是目瞪口呆。
姬扶摇身形舞动，翩若惊鸿，每一掌落下，方岩都在不断暴退。
十丈！
二十丈！
三十丈！
方岩的脸上露出难以置信之色。
他竟然挡不住！
念及此。
方岩当机立断，催动了自己的底牌。
“坚如磐石！”
轰然间，比斗台上凝出了一个山峰的虚影，方岩立在原地，如同巨岳一般，不可撼动。
方岩一脸肃然，同时也十分自信的开口。
“师妹，没想到你的攻伐之力竟然如此强大！我不得不祭出我的底牌！”
“玄尊境之下无人可破！若是三招你不能破开我的防御，那么你就认输吧……”
还没有说完，姬扶摇直接出手了。
“焚天决！”
姬扶摇的身上涌出无尽汹涌的灵能，灵火之力滂湃鼓动，炽烈的光芒向着四周倾泻。
大成之境的灵火之力，再加上帝阶功法的攻伐之力！
呼吸间，滔天的灵火直接席卷整个比斗台，将方岩祭出的异象淹没了。
“咔嚓！”
“咔嚓！”
方岩的巨岳虚影不断破碎湮灭！
他的身体如同断线风筝一样飞出了比斗台，重重砸在了地上，直接不省人事。
重伤！
方岩，败！
见此一幕，场中变得一片死寂。
所有人都震惊的看着姬扶摇。
这怎么可能？
方岩的炼体秘术极其强大，号称玄尊境之下不可破。
今天竟然输给了姬扶摇！
而且姬扶摇和方岩之间差了两个小境界啊！
以下伐上，碾压！
所有人的内心都掀起了一道滔天巨浪。
姬扶摇的实力超出了所有人的预料。
宗主看向地上被烧成焦黑的方岩，马上说道，“快把方岩送回炼体峰，治疗！”
很快，几个弟子抬着担架，将方岩送走了。
content_en:
Seeing this, everyone was shocked.
What?
Ji Fuyao knocked Fang Yan away with one palm?
The next moment.
Everyone was even more stunned.
Ji Fuyao's figure danced as gracefully as a mighty dragon, and with every palm landing, Fang Yan continued to retreat violently.
Ten feet!
Twenty feet!
Thirty feet!
Fang Yan had a look of disbelief on his face.
He couldn't stop it!
Think of this.
Fang Yan made a prompt decision and activated his trump card.
"Solid as a rock!"
Suddenly, a shadow of a mountain peak formed on the competition platform. Fang Yan stood on the spot, like a giant mountain, unshakable.
Fang Yan looked solemn and spoke confidently.
"Junior sister, I didn't expect your offensive power to be so powerful! I have to show my trump card!"
"No one in the Xuanzun realm can break through me! If you can't break through my defense with three moves, then you have to admit defeat..."
Before he finished speaking, Ji Fuyao took action directly.
"Burning Heaven Jue!"
Ji Fuyao's body surged with endless spiritual energy, the power of spiritual fire surged, and blazing light poured out all around.
The power of spiritual fire in the realm of Dacheng, coupled with the offensive power of God-level skills!
As he breathed, the monstrous spiritual fire swept directly across the entire competition platform, drowning the vision that Fang Yan had sacrificed.
"Crack!"
"Crack!"
Fang Yan's giant mountain phantom continues to be shattered and annihilated!
His body flew out of the competition platform like a kite with a broken string, and hit the ground heavily, causing him to fall unconscious.
Seriously injured!
Fang Yan, defeated!
Seeing this scene, the place became dead silent.
Everyone looked at Ji Fuyao in shock.
How is this possible?
Fang Yan's secret body refining technique is extremely powerful and is said to be indestructible under the Xuanzun realm.
He actually lost to Ji Fuyao today!
Moreover, there is a slight difference between Ji Fuyao and Fang Yan!
Cut down below and crush!
There was a huge wave in everyone's heart.
Ji Fuyao's strength exceeded everyone's expectations.
The sect leader looked at Fang Yan, who was burned to black on the ground, and immediately said, "Hurry and send Fang Yan back to the Body Refining Peak for treatment!"
Soon, several disciples carried a stretcher and sent Fang Yan away.
